notice: All examples use invented sources and results. They are illustrations, not reports from Jasmine’s workplace or measured outcomes.
modelAgnosticNote: Use the AI tool approved for your work with supplied material. Wording and layout will vary by model; look for the evidence, uncertainty and review decisions shown here. Connections and recurring runs depend on your setup.
goal: Check the effort behind one workflow.

supplied.label: Comparable work | Fictional week
supplied.text: Five completed drafts per approach, with the same acceptance requirements assumed. No failed or unfinished cases in this illustration. Effort is active person-minutes, not agent runtime or elapsed time.

supplied.label: Effort records | Invented measurements
supplied.text: Manual work: 25 minutes per draft including preparation and checks, with zero separate baseline maintenance explicitly assumed. Assisted work: 7 minutes per draft including preparation, review and corrections, plus 10 minutes of maintenance for the week.

supplied.label: Unknowns and request
supplied.text: Setup effort, monetary cost and use of attention are unknown. Equal quality is assumed for the example, not independently verified. Return a decision draft and one next measurement; make no workflow or staffing changes.

steps.label: Supply a fair comparison
steps.description: Name the completed task, period and quality requirements. Provide human effort for both approaches and label assumptions, estimates and missing values.

steps.label: Prepare a decision draft
steps.description: Explain what the effort comparison can establish, showing a traceable calculation. Separate the recurring difference from unknown setup, cost, quality and impact.

steps.label: Choose the next measurement
steps.description: Check comparability and arithmetic, then decide whether the evidence supports keeping, revising or stopping. Unknown effort stays unknown rather than becoming zero.

sections.label: Recurring human effort
sections.text: Manual: 125 active person-minutes. Assisted: 45 active person-minutes including maintenance. Difference: 80 minutes before setup. [Supplied fictional effort records]

sections.label: Quality and unknowns
sections.text: Equal acceptance requirements are assumed for the illustration, not independently validated evidence. Setup effort and monetary cost are unknown.

sections.label: Recommendation
sections.text: Revise the assessment: collect setup effort and real comparable case measurements before claiming an all-in benefit.

sections.label: Next evidence
sections.text: Have the workflow owner record active preparation, review, corrections and maintenance for the next comparable completed cases; retain failures and exclusions.

outputRequirements: Comparable cases, units and a traceable calculation
Assumptions, missing evidence and setup treatment
Quality, monetary cost and use of attention kept distinct from effort
A reviewed keep, revise or stop proposal and one next measurement
review: Were the cases comparable, and did you count all human effort once, including unsuccessful attempts in your real comparison?
Do the known results support the decision, or do you first need setup, quality or other missing evidence?
